source_sql: SELECT p.patient_id FROM hc_patients p JOIN hc_labs l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id WHERE p.age_years >= 18 AND p.consent_flag = 1 AND l.result_value >= 100 ORDER BY p.patient_id
target_sql: SELECT p.patient_id FROM hc_patients p JOIN hc_labs l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id WHERE p.age_years >= 18 AND p.consent_flag = 1 AND l.result_value >= 100 ORDER BY p.patient_id

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date) AS treatment_days FROM hc_treatments WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, CAST(AGE(end_date, start_date) AS BIGINT) AS treatment_days FROM hc_treatments WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY patient_id

source_sql: SELECT consent_flag, COUNT(*) AS total_patients, SUM(CASE WHEN age_years >= 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS senior_patients FROM hc_patients GROUP BY consent_flag ORDER BY consent_flag
target_sql: SELECT consent_flag, COUNT(*) AS total_patients, SUM(CASE WHEN age_years >= 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS senior_patients FROM hc_patients GROUP BY consent_flag ORDER BY consent_flag NULLS FIRST

source_sql: SELECT p.patient_id, COALESCE(l.result_value, 0) AS normalized_lab FROM hc_patients p LEFT JOIN hc_labs l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id ORDER BY p.patient_id
target_sql: SELECT p.patient_id, COALESCE(l.result_value, 0) AS normalized_lab FROM hc_patients p LEFT JOIN hc_labs l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id ORDER BY p.patient_id

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, DATE_ADD(index_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS next_visit FROM hc_patients ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, index_date + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AS next_visit FROM hc_patients ORDER BY patient_id

source_sql: SELECT p.patient_id, l.result_value, t.start_date FROM hc_patients p JOIN hc_labs l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id JOIN hc_treatments t ON p.patient_id = t.patient_id WHERE p.age_years >= 18 AND p.consent_flag = 1 AND l.result_value IS NOT NULL AND t.start_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.patient_id
target_sql: SELECT p.patient_id, l.result_value, t.start_date FROM hc_patients p JOIN hc_labs l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id JOIN hc_treatments t ON p.patient_id = t.patient_id WHERE p.age_years >= 18 AND p.consent_flag = 1 AND l.result_value IS NOT NULL AND t.start_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.patient_id

source_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.age_years >= 65 THEN 'senior' ELSE 'other' END AS age_group, AVG(DATEDIFF(t.end_date, t.start_date)) AS avg_days FROM hc_patients p JOIN hc_treatments t ON p.patient_id = t.patient_id WHERE p.age_years IS NOT NULL AND t.start_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.age_years >= 65 THEN 'senior' ELSE 'other' END ORDER BY age_group
target_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.age_years >= 65 THEN 'senior' ELSE 'other' END AS age_group, AVG(t.end_date - t.start_date) AS avg_days FROM hc_patients p JOIN hc_treatments t ON p.patient_id = t.patient_id WHERE p.age_years IS NOT NULL AND t.start_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.age_years >= 65 THEN 'senior' ELSE 'other' END ORDER BY age_group

source_sql: SELECT p.consent_flag, COUNT(*) AS patient_count, COUNT(l.result_value) AS available_labs, SUM(CASE WHEN l.result_value >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS elevated_labs FROM hc_patients p LEFT JOIN hc_labs l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id GROUP BY p.consent_flag ORDER BY p.consent_flag
target_sql: SELECT p.consent_flag, COUNT(*) AS patient_count, COUNT(l.result_value) AS available_labs, SUM(CASE WHEN l.result_value >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS elevated_labs FROM hc_patients p LEFT JOIN hc_labs l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id GROUP BY p.consent_flag ORDER BY p.consent_flag NULLS FIRST

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, DATE_ADD(index_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS followup_date FROM hc_patients WHERE MONTH(index_date) = 12 ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, CAST(index_date + INTERVAL '30 DAY' AS DATE) AS followup_date FROM hc_patients WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM index_date) = 12 ORDER BY patient_id

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, result_value FROM hc_labs WHERE result_value > (SELECT AVG(result_value) FROM hc_labs) ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, result_value FROM hc_labs WHERE result_value > (SELECT AVG(result_value) FROM hc_labs) ORDER BY patient_id
